llm_justification.summary: This prediction market tracks the length of Harvey Weinstein's prison sentence in a NY retrial. It is a purely legal/personal outcome with no cash-flow, macro, sector, or commodity linkage to any liquid public-market instrument. The Weinstein Company is defunct and untraded, so there is no direct proxy. This is a clear no-signal case: any coincident asset move would be noise, and confidence in any directional mapping is near zero.

failure_modes: A weak/absent proxy — there is genuinely no liquid instrument exposed
